title: Tanker hit in Strait of Hormuz, engine room damaged
excerpt: Tanker struck by unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz on 4 October, engine room damaged, crew reported safe, UKMTO said. Vanguard Tech identified the vessel as LIPSI.
